schema.text: Do you rarely cycle because you do not have a bike or e-bike you can use?

ar.#Do you rarely cycle because you do not: هل تعود قلّة ركوبك الدراجة إلى أنه ليس لديك دراجة أو دراجة كهربائية يمكنك استخدامها؟

de.#Do you rarely cycle because you do not: Fahren Sie selten Rad, weil Sie kein Fahrrad oder E-Bike zur Verfügung haben?

en.#Do you rarely cycle because you do not: Do you rarely cycle because you do not have a bike or e-bike you can use?

fa.#Do you rarely cycle because you do not: آیا کم دوچرخه‌سواری می‌کنید چون دوچرخه یا دوچرخهٔ برقی در اختیار ندارید؟

fr.#Do you rarely cycle because you do not: Faites-vous rarement du vélo parce que vous n'avez pas de vélo ou de vélo électrique à disposition ?

hu.#Do you rarely cycle because you do not: Azért kerékpározik ritkán, mert nincs használható kerékpárja vagy e-bike-ja?

it.#Do you rarely cycle because you do not: Vai poco in bici perché non hai una bici o una e-bike da usare?

tr.#Do you rarely cycle because you do not: Kullanabileceğiniz bir bisikletiniz veya elektrikli bisikletiniz olmadığı için mi nadiren bisiklet sürüyorsunuz?
